title: Vortex Cherry Raspberry Blueberry 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Tidal Vape Vortex Nic Salt Cherry Raspberry Blueberry combines the rich pop of Cherry with the tangy sharpness of Raspberry and the smooth jammy sweetness of Blueberry. This balanced, triple-berry medley offers a layered and satisfying vaping experience, ideal for vapers who love bold, fruity blends. Blended with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Tidal Vape Vortex nic salts are perfect for Mouth-To-Lung (MTL) devices such as pod systems and starter kits. The nicotine salt formulation provides a smooth throat sensation and rapid nicotine relief, delivering bold flavours and discreet vapour without any harshness. Tidal Vape Vortex Nic Salts offer a more economical and sustainable option compared to single-use disposable vape bars, providing your favourite flavours in a 10ml format designed for use with refillable vape devices. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, Cherry Raspberry Blueberry is an excellent choice for adult smokers and vapers seeking bold and versatile flavour options.
